title: Apache JMeter
tagline: Load, stress, and API performance testing — protocol-level, from first HTTP sampler to CI gates.
who: QA engineers who already write Playwright/API tests and need to prove the system holds up under concurrent load.
outcomes: Build a JMeter test plan (Thread Groups, samplers, assertions, correlation) without treating the GUI as a load generator
Design load vs stress vs spike vs soak profiles with think time and pacing
Run CLI tests, read percentiles, generate HTML dashboards, and fail a pipeline on performance thresholds
